name: Real Madrid Foundation Clinic – All-In Pack Information
franja: Real Madrid Foundation Clinic · All-In Pack

d.text: The countdown to Madrid is on, and we know you’re just as excited as we are! We’re now happy to share your **accommodation details** along with a few more important updates to help you prepare for the trip.

d.v1: Novotel Madrid Campo de las Naciones 4*

d.title: Important information
d.text:
Please note that, as previously informed, **the period for modifying your registration is closed** and we can’t guarantee you the needed modifications. If you need to make any change on your registration **you have to inform us via email**.
Changes regarding sizes, participants, extra nights or type of rooms are not possible.

d.label: Your hotel will be:
d.title: Novotel Madrid Campo de las Naciones 4*
d.text:
Campo De Las Naciones, C. de Ámsterdam, N° 3, Barajas, 28042 Madrid
Check-in: from 2 PM
Check-out: until 12 PM

d.f1_alt: Tentative Schedule - RMF Clinic November 2026 - All-In Pack

d.text: We’ll be using the **Telegram app** to communicate during the RMF Training Clinic. This is the same app used during the RMF Summer Camps, so you may already be familiar with it. If you no longer have it, please download the app again and join **the event’s official channel** to stay updated. Through this channel, we will share news, schedules, and updates daily.
